data.cultural_impact: Saint Ludgero, also known as Ludger, was a missionary and bishop in Friesland, present-day Netherlands and Germany. He played an essential role in converting the Frisian people from paganism to Christianity during the early medieval period. Ludgero's name reflects his warrior nature, which inspired many Christian warriors, including crusaders, throughout history.
